---
mode: aim
description: Inspect or refresh AIM project specialists for the selected suppliers
---

Run `/aim configure-agents` using
`docs/workflow/project-agent-configuration.md`. Read `aim.roles.yaml`, then
`aim.profile.yaml`, propose project-specific role expertise and native-agent
changes, preserve user edits unless replacement is approved, and never modify
`.aim/state.json` or gate state.
